text:
sarah: Heads-up — Athena POC (Delphi Labs) hit a procurement/legal blocker. They want SLA raised to 99.95% (from our standard 99.9), DPA redlines around logging & subprocessors, and a separate billing signer. Need order form + sign routing by EOD.

raj: Ack. pricing question — if we agree 99.95 we need to add crediting language. can offer 1% credit of monthly invoice for breach? @maria is that ok?

maria: Put proposed fallback language inline below. We cannot accept uncapped liability. Also need exact subprocessor list + KMS assurances. Paste into OF and send redlines to their counsel. Suggested SLA patch:

"SLA: Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to maintain 99.95% uptime. For any calendar month where uptime < 99.95%, Customer may claim a service credit equal to 5% of that month's invoice, capped at 25% annually."

luke: On routing — customer requires bill signer to be a different legal entity (Delphi Billing LLC). DocuSign mapping will need custom recipient order and tax id on the envelope. We can do that but ops needs the billing entity legal name and email.

raj: Also they asked for PO on every invoice; finance will need invoice-to and PO number. @kevin-finance can you confirm net terms handling if we add PO requirement?

kevin-finance: We can accept PO requirement. Net30 still ok. need billing contact + remit address + tax info. I'll prepare a one-page PO addendum.

maria: DPA redlines — they're asking for 90-day data deletion verification and subprocessor audit rights. We can offer annual attestation and 30-day notice for subprocessors, not audit rights. Proposed DPA reply:

- annual SOC/ISO attestation + KMS integration note
- 30-day notice for new subprocessors
- deletion confirmation: we provide certificate of deletion within 30 days of request

raj: Customer asked if we can do on-prem ingestion for logs (they are in regulated space). That is heavy; need to escalate to eng-hosting. @simon-bot can you create a runtime ticket?

simon-bot: ticket #INF-4827 created — eng-runtime to evaluate on-prem ingestion for Delphi. Assigned to @luke.

sarah: Plan: @maria will draft DPA/OF responses, @kevin-finance will draft PO addendum, @luke will confirm signer/email for billing & DocuSign mapping. I'll coordinate with the AE to get counterparty counsel contact. target: EOD today. :clock3: 

maria: I'll drop redline pdf in the thread when ready.

raj: thx. if anyone gets exec sign required, ping me — can escalate credits.

kevin-finance: sending billing template now.
